# p10k-rs v0.2.5

**The "Windows is finally portable" release.** Closes the v0.2.3 → v0.2.4
round-trip. v0.2.3 added the Windows MSVC release matrix prematurely
(Unix-only `rustix` API surface across 8+ files); v0.2.4 reverted and
documented the work. v0.2.5 lands the actual port and re-enables the
release matrix.

## What's new

### Windows binaries

`cargo check --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --workspace --locked` exits
0 with zero warnings. The release pipeline now builds `.zip` artifacts
for `x86_64-pc-windows-msvc` and `aarch64-pc-windows-msvc`, with
matching `.sha256` sidecars and sigstore signatures.

**This is the first Windows tag run.** If the pipeline succeeds, the
release page will carry six unix `.tar.gz` artifacts plus two Windows
`.zip` artifacts (plus sigstore bundles and provenance attestations).
If it fails, the unix artifacts still upload — Windows failure isolates
to its own matrix entry.

### What works on Windows

- Prompt rendering, every segment that doesn't depend on Unix-only
  syscalls, the entire diagnostic CLI surface (`doctor`, `verify`,
  `daemon-health`, `version`), all TOML schema knobs.
- Git state via `ShellOut` or `GixBackend`. `gitstatusd` falls back to
  `ShellOut` (no FIFO IPC on Windows).

### What's reduced on Windows

See the new [`docs/src/windows.md`](https://github.com/scurran1986/powerlevel10k-rs/blob/v0.2.5/docs/src/windows.md)
page for the per-feature status table. Headline reductions: no
`root_indicator`, no privilege-aware `context`, no DECSET 2026 sync
output, no OSC 4 truecolor probe, no ioctl `TIOCGWINSZ` (falls through
to `$COLUMNS` / 80).

### `install.ps1`

PowerShell installer at the repo root. Mirrors `install.sh`'s argument
surface (`-Version`, `-Prefix`, `-NoProfile`, `-NoFonts`, `-VerifyOnly`,
`-Uninstall`) with platform substitutions:

```pwsh
# One-liner install (current user, latest release)
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scurran1986/powerlevel10k-rs/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

**Draft only — first ship.** Two TODOs flagged in-file:

1. Sigstore certificate-identity / OIDC issuer values — need the actual
   strings the Windows release pipeline emits.
2. Per-exe `.sha256` sidecar — currently only per-zip; verifying an
   extracted exe needs a matching change to the release workflow.

Will iterate on a v0.2.6 once the first Windows tag run validates the
artifact layout.

### Architecture preserved

- Schema unchanged. Bundled themes byte-for-byte identical.
- Load-bearing invariants (`SafeText` chokepoint, spawn-per-prompt
  sync, `unsafe` budget in `p10k-rs-git` only) all hold.
- Toolchain: Rust 1.88 (unchanged).

## Compatibility

- Wire-stability discipline preserved across `daemon-health --json` /
  `version --json` / `verify --json` / `doctor --json`.
- Unix users see no behavioural change. All five Linux gates
  (build / test / clippy `-D warnings` / fmt / doc `-D warnings`)
  stayed green at every phase commit.

## Verification

```sh
# unix (unchanged from prior releases)
p10k-rs --version              # 0.2.5
p10k-rs verify                 # gitstatusd sha256 vs. bundled pin
p10k-rs doctor                 # 9-check environmental probe
gh attestation verify p10k-rs-0.2.5-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz \
   --repo scurran1986/powerlevel10k-rs

# windows (new)
.\install.ps1 -VerifyOnly      # validates downloaded zip against sidecar
Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 p10k-rs-0.2.5-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip
gh attestation verify p10k-rs-0.2.5-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip `
   --repo scurran1986/powerlevel10k-rs
```

## Known issues

- `install.ps1` untested on a real Windows host; iterate in v0.2.6
  once the first tag run surfaces actual artifact paths and sigstore
  identity strings.
- Two reduced-functionality segments on Windows (`root_indicator`,
  `context` privilege state) and four reduced-capability probes
  (DECSET 2026, OSC 4, `TIOCGWINSZ`, ACL safety check). Each lands as
  a future slice when there's a Windows-native fallback worth writing.
